description: Dependency vulnerability scan (SCA) via OSV.dev querybatch: send up to 500 packages, or paste a lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, composer.lock, requirements.txt, Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.mod, go.sum, Gemfile.lock; auto-detected). Returns a severity summary plus, per vulnerable package, advisories with CVE aliases, CVSS, fixed versions and a heuristic safe upgrade. 256 KB body limit. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/osv-scan

details.description: Fetch full advisory details (default true; up to 60 per call, cached)

lockfile.description: Alternative: the full text of a lockfile/manifest

lockfileType.description: Optional override: package-lock.json, yarn.lock, composer.lock, requirements.txt, Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.mod, go.sum, Gemfile.lock

packages.description: Array of {ecosystem, name, version} or {purl} objects (max 500)

name: osv_scan_batch
title: Osv Scan
